title: TRAVEL Slovakia postcode stop
description: Canonical TRAVEL Slovak geographic postcode record. This schema and the Slovakia CONTENT_STANDARD.md define the production structure for Slovak PSČ records. Production lifecycle: placeholder records contain only postcode and status (plus optional data_version); validated and published records contain the complete production content. Only published records are eligible for map display.

postcode.description: Five-digit Slovak geographic postal code (PSČ), stored as a string without a space, e.g. 81101. Display with the conventional space, e.g. 811 01. Special-purpose and non-geographic codes are excluded.

city.description: The principal municipality (obec) or town that geographically characterises this PSČ area and serves as its representative locality. Select it using verified geographic/address evidence and the actual territorial relationship of the PSČ. Do not derive it from a post office, postal directory display name, correspondence address or arbitrary best-known town. If the geographic PSČ spans several municipalities, select the best-supported representative municipality while researching the full defensible area.

district.description: An officially documented mestská časť, miestna časť, urban district or other relevant part within the selected representative municipality, where applicable; otherwise null. Do not put a neighbouring municipality or every settlement in the postal area here.

county.description: The official okres containing the selected representative municipality. Use the official Slovak name.

state.description: The samosprávny kraj (kraj) containing the selected representative municipality. Use the official Slovak name.

representative_place.description: One human-readable place or feature that genuinely characterises the geographic PSČ area. It need not be a tourist attraction or geometric centre.

representative_point.description: WGS84 coordinates for the same postcode-level representative place. This is not a fact location or access point.

access_point.description: Legacy/game compatibility point for Europe Explorer arrival or navigation. It may be identical to representative_point; do not invent a separate point when the representative point is already suitable. It is not a fact location. Keep this field compatible with the shared record structure.

plz_source.description: Specific source used to verify the Slovak PSČ's existence and geographic versus special-purpose classification. Slovenská pošta is the primary postal authority for this postal claim; RAGEO and official mapping sources corroborate the geography of places and addresses.

postcode_authority.description: Postal authority for confirming the code's existence and geographic versus special-purpose classification: Slovenská pošta. This does not require checking whether any post office is currently open or operational.

postcode_source_dataset.description: Optional name of the official Slovak postal source or dataset used.

postcode_source_release.description: Optional release/version of the postal source, if stated by the source.

postcode_source_checked_at.description: Date on which the postal source was checked.

postcode_conflict_note.description: Explain any unresolved or resolved conflict between Slovak postal and geographic evidence.

delivery_office_note.description: Optional contextual note about a post office or postal assignment, if genuinely relevant. Current operating status or closure history is not required. Never use a post office location as the postcode representative point merely because it exists.

postcode_override_reason.description: Documented reason for any justified manual resolution or override. Never use this to conceal missing evidence.

geographic_authority.description: Authority used for the geographic or administrative claim: RAGEO/Ministry of Interior for address points; ŠÚ SR and official territorial-unit registers for administrative hierarchy; ÚGKK SR/ZBGIS for geographic identification and coordinate corroboration.

district_type.description: Optional clarification of the Slovak district value: municipal_part = officially recognised part of a municipality; urban_district = mestská časť or urban district; local_part = miestna časť; settlement = settlement within the municipality; locality = another documented local area.

status.description: Production lifecycle state. placeholder = intentionally empty geographic postcode record with no content fields; validated = complete reworked content waiting for the separate final audit; published = successfully audited record eligible for map display. The map must load published records only.

data_version.description: Optional manually controlled record data version. Preserve the existing value exactly during rework and audit. Change it only after the complete requested audit scope has passed and only on the user's explicit instruction. This is independent of status.

location.description: Independent physical/map location of the subject of this fact. Do not copy representative_point or access_point automatically. Use a defensible exact, approximate, area-representative or historical-approximate point according to the Slovak Content Standard; use null only when no meaningful point can be established.

map_category.description: Exactly one stable, language-neutral value from the shared 17-value TRAVEL map-category taxonomy. It classifies the fact's primary subject, not its physical location.

name.description: Name of the actual mapped object, feature or orientation point. If an approximate public reference point is used, name that point rather than falsely presenting it as the exact historical or factual site.

address.description: Verified postal address of the mapped point, if one exists; otherwise null.

type.description: Řízený český slovník typů polohy faktu v jednotném čísle. postal_area označuje faktum vztahující se k oblasti PSČ bez jediného konkrétního fyzického místa.

accuracy.description: exact = verified point on the specific object; approximate = approximate point for a known location; area_representative = representative point within an extended area; historical_approximate = uncertain historical position or an explicitly approximate orientation point.

source.description: Direct URL supporting the identification or geographic position of the chosen map point.

fact_location.description: WGS84 coordinates for the fact's physical subject or a clearly identified representative/orientation point, following the Slovak Content Standard. The name, type and accuracy must honestly describe the actual mapped point.

$comment: SLOVAKIA CONTENT STANDARD: Slovak geographic PSČ only. Slovak postal authority is Slovenská pošta; RAGEO supports address geography, ŠÚ SR official administrative units, and ÚGKK SR/ZBGIS geographic corroboration. Preserve the shared TRAVEL record structure, editorial categories, A-D priorities, 17-value map_category taxonomy and seven required languages. access_point is a secondary Europe Explorer/game field and may equal representative_point. The principal geographic enrichment priority is facts[].location, where meaningful map points should be resolved under the Slovak Content Standard rather than left null by default. Slovakia has its own administrative descriptions and controlled district_type vocabulary. Do not modify Czech or German schemas or records.
